scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix server" "npx --yes wait-on tcp:3007 && npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && node scripts/copy-client-build.mjs
